name: Engelturm
description: A former angel stronghold near Havengul, full of tools for dismantling the dead, where Gisa has settled.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
timeline.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
timeline.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
timeline.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
timeline.quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Gisa has settled in the former angel stronghold
relations.quote: How I wish you would visit me here in Engelturm!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.
